text: Good morning, everyone! I started at the village green and waved hello to the new day, then sat a while on the bench by the cottage, thinking of my bees. After that I took a lovely swim in the pond, which woke me right up. Now I'm here, happy and ready to hear about your mornings.
speaker: ada

text: I'm Bo. I don't say much in the morning. I walked out to the orchard and back, and mostly listened to the grass and the wind. I hummed a little tune on the way, and it was the best part of my morning.
speaker: bo
